scope: Preimplementation design review, exact patch not reviewed yet
conditions: No src modification or business/DB/Mock/G0/launcher execution; this is a diagnostic design only.
Preserve original stage context enter/body/exit and call each original function exactly once.
Observe only the five original stage bodies of the captured diagnostic instance while boundary.entered; require the owner thread and clear the stage in finally.
Use two thread_time_ns readings per observed call; aggregate fixed 5x4 metrics and a stack with explicit finite maximum depth.
Compute exclusive only by subtracting direct observed-child inclusive CPU once; no system-exclusive claim or addition of overlapping inclusive values.
No typed-model __dict__ or other new attribute reads. Input volume UNKNOWN by default; optionally exact native O(1) container lengths under clearly distinct element/byte names.
Codec successful exact-bytes output length may be recorded as codec_output_bytes; do not claim SHA was measured or non-codec field counts are bytes.
No extra pins, scans, encodes, hashes, dumps, repr, payload logging, argument retention, cProfile or hot-path I/O.
Observer-only failures including clock/stack/aggregation errors mark incomplete and disable observation without replacing the original return or any BaseException; never retry originals.
Serialize the bounded aggregate after the original stop/unwind, never inside active business stages.

Pure synthetic tests must prove gate/thread/interval exclusions, direct-child nesting accounting, exact original call counts, failure/exception identity, stack cleanup and overflow/failing-clock fallback.
Nonzero observer overhead must be explicit; no historical cross-observer performance comparison, G0 speedup claim, lease change or execution grant.
